files.profile.env:
# Harness profile generated by Shipyard for Kho (backend/ java-spring + frontend/ ts-react-vite).
# Lanes bound to this project (lane-add.sh --profile) read it. Remove the next line to stop Shipyard regenerating it.
SHIPYARD_GENERATED=1
BACKEND_DIR="backend"
FRONTEND_DIR="frontend"
API_PATH=""
DB_SERVICE="postgres"
BASE_BRANCH="development"
INTEGRATION_BRANCH="development"
BRANCH_PREFIX="feat/"
TEST_PATHS="src/test/ tests/ *.spec.ts *.test.tsx *.test.ts"
GENERATED_MERGE_PATHS=""
MIGRATIONS_DIR=""
QC_BOOT_ENV=""
OPENHANDS_BASE_IMAGE="${OPENHANDS_BASE_IMAGE:-maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21}"
OPENHANDS_EXTRA_PACKAGES="${OPENHANDS_EXTRA_PACKAGES:-nodejs npm}"
IMPL_AGENTS="1"
files.integrations.env:
# Integrations for kho-hang (generated by Shipyard). The platform project makes its lanes run the role pipeline.
PLATFORM_PROJECT_ID="proj_1"
TRACKER_ENABLED="0"
DEV_QC_ENABLED="0"
CI_WAIT_ENABLED="0"
files.hooks/bootstrap.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# bootstrap: install dependencies — generated by Shipyard for this project's stack (see profile.env). Edit freely.
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$PROFILE_DIR/profile.env"
( cd "$LANE_DIR/$BACKEND_DIR" && if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then BUILD=(./mvnw -q -B); RUN=(./mvnw -q spring-boot:run); else BUILD=(./gradlew -q); RUN=(./gradlew -q bootRun); fi && if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then "${BUILD[@]}" -DskipTests dependency:go-offline; else "${BUILD[@]}" dependencies >/dev/null; fi ) || echo "bootstrap: dependency prefetch failed (will retry at build)" >&2
( cd "$LANE_DIR/$FRONTEND_DIR" && (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline || npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline) )
files.hooks/boot.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# boot: start this lane's app in the background, then return — generated by Shipyard for this project's stack (see profile.env). Edit freely.
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$PROFILE_DIR/profile.env"
export DB_HOST="$PG_HOST" DB_PORT="$PG_PORT" DB_USER="$PG_USER" DB_PASSWORD="$PG_PASS" DB_NAME="${DB_NAME_OVERRIDE:-$DB_NAME}"
cd "$LANE_DIR/$BACKEND_DIR"
if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then BUILD=(./mvnw -q -B); RUN=(./mvnw -q spring-boot:run); else BUILD=(./gradlew -q); RUN=(./gradlew -q bootRun); fi
harness_spawn api "$LANE_DIR/$BACKEND_DIR" env PORT="$API_PORT" "${RUN[@]}"
harness_spawn fe "$LANE_DIR/$FRONTEND_DIR" env BACKEND_PORT="$API_PORT" npx vite --port "$FE_PORT" --strictPort --host 0.0.0.0
files.hooks/health.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# health: exit 0 when the lane's app answers — generated by Shipyard for this project's stack (see profile.env). Edit freely.
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$PROFILE_DIR/profile.env"
curl -fsS --retry 90 --retry-delay 2 --retry-connrefused --max-time 5 "http://localhost:$API_PORT/actuator/health" >/dev/null
curl -fsS --retry 60 --retry-delay 2 --retry-connrefused --max-time 5 "$FE_URL/" >/dev/null
files.hooks/ci-gate.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ci-gate: build + tests before a push (TEST_DATABASE_URL = an isolated DB) — generated by Shipyard for this project's stack (see profile.env). Edit freely.
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$PROFILE_DIR/profile.env"
DB_NAME_OVERRIDE="${TEST_DATABASE_URL##*/}"
export DB_HOST="$PG_HOST" DB_PORT="$PG_PORT" DB_USER="$PG_USER" DB_PASSWORD="$PG_PASS" DB_NAME="${DB_NAME_OVERRIDE:-$DB_NAME}"
( cd "$LANE_DIR/$BACKEND_DIR" && if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then BUILD=(./mvnw -q -B); RUN=(./mvnw -q spring-boot:run); else BUILD=(./gradlew -q); RUN=(./gradlew -q bootRun); fi && if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then "${BUILD[@]}" test; else "${BUILD[@]}" test; fi )
"$HARNESS_ROOT/bin/with-lock.sh" build -- bash -c "cd '$LANE_DIR/$FRONTEND_DIR' && npm run build && npm test"
